name: SBCLIENT
description:
Developed by BigMMan and Shikiimorii.

A Hypixel SkyBlock client mod with:
• Fancy status bars: health, mana, defense, vitality, speed, air and XP, freely movable, resizable and recolourable, in Classic, Segmented or SkyblockAddons style
• Customisable action bar: move, scale, restyle and hide parts of it
• Dungeon secrets display and a rare dungeon drop tracker with run counter
• Item protection with a recolourable star
• Backpack and ender chest previews
• Movable held item name
• Animated inventory GIFs
• Commission overlay, keystrokes with CPS, inventory HUD
• Custom player sizes, own nametag in F5, Wall Licker
• SHIKIMODE: an all-pink ShikiClient theme

Open the menu with /sbclient.
